body.statement: For positive-definite \(H,H'\) with spectra in \([\lambda,\Lambda]\), \(d_H(\Theta_{TY}(H,\preceq),\Theta_{TY}(H',\preceq))\le L_\beta\|H-H'\|_{\mathrm{op}}\), including points at which distinct ideal branches coincide.
body.justification: Hausdorff stability is the margin-free transfer principle from covariance uncertainty to set-valued causal uncertainty.
body.gap: Structure-uncertainty papers emphasize nonsmoothness of selected effects; the set-valued map admits a uniform bound without a swap margin.
body.consumer: Any valid covariance region can be converted into a whole-fiber region without testing which effects collide.
